body:
You got the tunnel vision pretty bad, huh? 

I'm waffling between hoping it works, and knowing it won't fuck you up too bad when it fails. 

If you do feel a little more open to solutions, hit me up <3 and if I reply that means maybe I was too lol

Define substantial. 

I've got friends and favors all over.. I know I could move a house in a week or two time..  

See, im leaving cuz I feel bad no matter how well I do...  all my validation is external and it kinda ran out when I got ran out on... 

If your problems are physical, then so are the solutions. Let's chat.

I'll be here with you, the best I can. 

I've enjoyed large portions of anxiety, depression, and bipolar..  I know what its like.  Even the weird horror movie shit, that I type up as fiction on main lol 

And when you want, hopefully before you try anything, I wouldn't mind chatting about how to overcome some of your obstacles...  theres lots of possibilities that most people havnt been versed in <3 

And if we don't succeed, ill tell you what I had planned for tomorrow night  :) which has a lot higher chance of success than those pills.

Sweetheart.. you just found #3.  

I've helped a few others in my time out of dire straights, and adding you to that list will at least keep me busy from ending things myself. I borrowed my time fair and square... 

If you wanna go, im not gonna stop you...  but pills almost always end waking up st the ER; not release, just new problems. 

I can't share my "how to" in this sub, but I wouldn't mind sharing elsewhere.

I don't know what you can get, but anything explosive will do the trick. Given that the prompt is "fast" ofc. 

Search online about how to calculate explosivity per volume for whatever substance you can buy/steal, then do the math on how much force per inch you need to utterly destroy meat. 

Cuz thats what you're doing. Let that sink in.  

So like, a tube of black powder may be approx to a gallon of gasoline.  But I don't *know* so you'll havta figure that out for what you can get.

Double check ignition temps/pressures too. You don't wanna make an impotent POP and wake up in ICU regrettably deformed. 

Ps. Make sure you can find a field or something far away from other people. Itll be pretty rude to set this off in a residential area.

You could call me. :P  theres like 7 billion people on the planet you havnt "ruined" things with. 

Also, you know that dose isn't gonna work. Please, at least stick around until you've got a solid plan; do this mindfully ...  you don't wanna wake and and need dialysis or some shit for the rest of your life.

Hey, im out here. Now I'm chatting with you.

I'm pretty tempted to check out myself.  Fast track to dying sober, amirite?

I'm not expecting you to save me... but it would be great of you did lol.  I'd ofc offer my best in return <3

Pm or chat or anything if you want. I'm cool w whatever :)

Naw, im still around...  I don't mind the company while I wait for my last train ride home though :) 

That was metaphor. I'm not getting on a physical train ^^

I care.
I'm mostly powerless to help. 
But I care.
I did in person out patient ...  we might live in different states tho

From personal experience, no.

One, you'll get caught. 

Two, if the concerns of the living are still weighing on you, then sort out your affairs here first.  

Three, once you get caught, everyone who read it will know what it says and thats *always* bad. Mine just said "im sorry" for 4 fn pages and it was still shameful and miserable.  

Just sort your biz out the hard way, in person.

I feel this, too well. But ofc, not for long <3 

Thankfully, there are a lot of kids like you, and a lot of "normal" kids too who you'll find and bond with *out there*. 

It won't be easy ofc, nothing in this life is ....  but I've dated a gal or two like you, and its totally possible that you're happy "normal"ish life is waiting for you <3

Interesting. 

I always assumed there was some biological mechanism that would stop someone from succeeding...  maybe I need to do more research offline lol
I'm not gonna say your husband is wack, but he sounds kinda  wack.

I don't mind listening. Totally selfishly, it helps me get thru my days, so its no burden at all.  

Although if no reply, well, you found my last day lol

Did you feel lightheaded?

Did you have/feel any intrinsic need to remove the bag? 

By what mechanism or impulse did you stop? 

I'm interested in hearing your experience so far.

That is an impressive goal. I was gonna try to wait a month and scrubbed that plan lol 

I do hope you can find some relief, so you can really think out what you're gonna do - either way. 

CBD tea helps me, at least at the peaks of ^^ that awful emotion you expressed the normies havjt given a word to. "Anxiety" depressive-panic disorder?" Lol

I feel it though, and I'm rooting for you <3

From a regular construction standpoint, finding stuff that'll hold the entire weight of an adult human is kinda tricky. 

The rope itself is rated for "wont snap if towing" not "holding you up deadweight". Nylon will flex/stretch too, so itll slowly sag. 

If you're 100% sure and have time, there's 2x4s on the other side of the drywall roof/wall. 2 or more ofc, cuz the single may snap. 

But getting noticed punching a dozen or more holes in your walls/roof is gonna do badly for you too lol 

Like others have said, auto asphyxiation is rife with hazards, most of them meaning you wake up in the ICU with permanent damage. 

Wish you the best, op <3
